gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1135. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Observatory Court (天文台圍): Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Observatory Road and terminating at a path leading to K.I.L. 441 as shown coloured red on P.W.D. Drawing No. R.K. 141 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 21st September, 1950.

No. 1135. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Walnut Street (合桃街): Road commencing at Fuk Tsun Street, crossing Larch Street and Bedford Road, and terminating at Tung Chau Street as shown coloured red on plan No. R.K. 140 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 21st September, 1950.
